name: elevated single leg squat
description: A one legged squat with the working foot raised on a step. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on a bench or box on one leg with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and bend the standing knee to lower.
Go as deep as you can while the knee tracks over your toes.
Push through the foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
